_doc: Machine-wide hardware admission budget for HEAVY runs. Read by mcp/noctusai/tools/noctus/dev/hw_admission.py. Phase resolution: env NOCTUS_HW_PHASE > hosts[<short hostname, lowercased>].phase > phase. hosts[].overrides replace individual knobs for one machine. Set placeholder phases from `noctus.dev.hw_admission action=report` data, never by guess. Becomes the owner-editable setting in the noc UI (core admin). KB § PATTERNS/devops/hardware-admission-budget.md
